(def select-keys
  "Returns a map containing only those entries in map whose key is in keys"
  (fn [map keyseq]
    (loop [ret {} keys (seq keyseq)]
      (if keys
        (let [key   (first keys)
              entry (get map key :cljs.core/not-found)]
          (recur
           (if (not= entry :cljs.core/not-found)
             (assoc ret key entry)
             ret)
           (next keys)))
        (-with-meta ret (meta map))))))
